title: 30kWh Dawnice Battery & Sunsynk Inverter Case Study
summary: Three 10kWh wall-mounted batteries, 30kWh in total, paired with a Sunsynk hybrid inverter in the UK.
challenge: Rising UK tariffs pushed the client toward self-consumption, but the capacity had to fit a house without giving up a plant room.
solution: Three 10kWh wall-mounted modules running as a 30kWh bank behind a Sunsynk hybrid inverter.
result: The wall format carries the capacity on the wall, which is what made the size acceptable in a domestic installation.
